### 1.Installation

###### (For Arch Linux)

👇 - Copy the following lines to the clipboard and paste it into your terminal 👇

```bash
sh -c "$(curl -fsSL
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tripleseven190504/dotfiles/main/setup_dotfiles.sh)"

```

###### [Manual Installation](INSTALL.MD)

And follow this [link](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VQ6MVky9EUk) to complete the installation

### 2.Information This repository was created to store my personal dotfiles

I hope you enjoy it!

- **Browser**:
  [Chrome](https://www.google.com/chrome/index.html)
- **OS**: [Arch
  Linux](https://archlinux.org/download/)
- **Shell**:
  [Zsh](https://sourceforge.net/projects/zsh/files/latest/download)
- **Terminal**: [Alacritty](https://github.com/alacritty/alacritty)
- **Text
  Editor**: [VS Code](https://code.visualstudio.com/)
- **WM**:
  [Mutter](https://mutter.gnome.org/)
- **DE**: [Gnome](https://www.gnome.org/)
